name: id comment: 承运商ID constraint: PRIMARY KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: name comment: 承运商名称 constraint: UNIQUE type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: code comment: 编码 constraint: UNIQUE type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: scope comment: 业务范围(domestic/international) constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: logo_url comment: Logo地址 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: status comment: 状态 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: created_at comment: 创建时间 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: updated_at comment: 更新时间 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: tracking_platforms comment: 追踪平台 note: scope=international 接 AfterShip/17TRACK 等聚合 API；scope=domestic 接顺丰/快递100等国内平台，无需状态映射 columns: - name: id comment: 平台ID constraint: PRIMARY KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: name comment: 平台名称 constraint: UNIQUE type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: scope comment: 业务范围(domestic/international) constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: api_key comment: API Key（加密） constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: webhook_secret comment: Webhook密钥（加密） constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: webhook_url comment: Webhook回调地址 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: status comment: 状态 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: last_synced_at comment: 最后同步时间 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: created_at comment: 创建时间 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: updated_at comment: 更新时间 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: platform_carrier_mappings comment: 平台承运商映射 note: 追踪平台↔Looply承运商的多对多映射。一个承运商可被多个平台覆盖(UPS 在 AfterShip 和 17TRACK 都有) columns: - name: id comment: 映射ID constraint: PRIMARY KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: tracking_platform_id comment: 关联追踪平台 constraint: FOREIGN KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: carrier_id comment: 关联Looply承运商 constraint: FOREIGN KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: platform_carrier_code comment: 平台承运商代码(如AfterShip slug=ups) constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: platform_carrier_name comment: 平台承运商显示名 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: is_default comment: 是否该平台默认通道 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: status comment: 状态 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: created_at comment: 创建时间 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: updated_at comment: 更新时间 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: status_mappings comment: 状态映射 note: 仅 international scope 平台使用。国内段不展示给买家、不需要状态归一化 columns: - name: id comment: 映射ID constraint: PRIMARY KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: tracking_platform_id comment: 关联追踪平台 constraint: FOREIGN KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: platform_tag comment: 平台一级状态(tag) constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: platform_tag_meaning comment: 一级状态含义 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: platform_subtag comment: 平台二级状态(subtag) constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: platform_subtag_meaning comment: 二级状态含义 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: internal_status comment: Looply内部状态 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: display_text_key comment: 买家端一级i18n key constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: display_detail_key comment: 买家端二级i18n key constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: sort_order comment: 排序 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: created_at comment: 创建时间 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: updated_at comment: 更新时间 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: relations: - from: orders to: order_items type: 1:N label: 包含商品行 color: '#FFA726' - from: products to: order_items type: 1:N label: 出现在订单行 color: '#FFA726' - from: orders to: shipments type: 1:N label: 产生运单 color: '#1976D2' penwidth: 1.8 - from: shipments to: shipment_items type: 1:N label: 包含商品 color: '#1976D2' - from: order_items to: shipment_items type: 1:N label: 发货明细 color: '#1976D2' - from: shipments to: tracking_checkpoints type: 1:N label: 轨迹节点 color: '#1976D2' - from: orders to: domestic_trackings type: 1:N label: 关联国内运单 color: '#8E24AA' penwidth: 1.8 - from: domestic_trackings to: domestic_checkpoints type: 1:N label: 轨迹节点 color: '#8E24AA' - from: carriers to: shipments type: 1:N label: 承运(国际) color: '#43A047' - from: tracking_platforms to: platform_carrier_mappings type: 1:N label: 映射的承运商 color: '#43A047' - from: carriers to: platform_carrier_mappings type: 1:N label: 在多平台的代码 color: '#43A047' - from: tracking_platforms to: status_mappings type: 1:N label: 状态映射(仅国际) color: '#43A047' - from: carriers to: domestic_trackings type: 1:N label: 承运(国内) color: '#8E24AA' design_rules: shipment_items: shipment_items 中间表支持拆包发货，记录每个包裹包含哪些商品。有 SKU 的商品通过 order_item_id 关联，无 SKU 的配件通过 shipments.remark 文本说明 shipment_type_enum: 'shipment_type 枚举值: outbound(正常发货), return(退货), exchange_return(换货退回), exchange_outbound(换货发出), replacement(补发)' status_mapping: status_mappings 表存储追踪平台一级(tag)+二级(subtag)状态→Looply内部状态的可配置映射。查找顺序：先精确匹配 tag+subtag，匹配不到则 fallback 到 tag 一级映射 checkpoint_mapping: tracking_checkpoints 接收 Webhook 时立即完成状态映射，存储 mapped_internal_status 和 display_i18n_key。买家端展示时直接读取，无需实时查表。历史轨迹不受后续映射规则调整影响 i18n_display: 买家端物流状态文案通过 i18n key 实现多语言：display_text_key 为一级状态文案，display_detail_key 为二级细粒度文案。映射时优先使用 display_detail_key，无值时 fallback 到 display_text_key subtag_mapping: 二级状态(subtag)映射为可选配置，platform_subtag 为空表示一级映射 domestic_scope: 国内段仅供内部运营监控，用户端不可见 carrier_unified: carriers 表统一管理国内/国际承运商，通过 scope 字段区分。承运商不直接持有平台代码，与平台的对应关系由 platform_carrier_mappings 维护 platform_carrier_mapping: platform_carrier_mappings 是承运商↔追踪平台的多对多关联：同一 UPS 在 AfterShip(slug=ups)、17TRACK(carrier_code=100002) 是不同代码。运单查询时根据该映射选取通道 tracking_platform_scope: tracking_platforms 通过 scope 区分：international(AfterShip/17TRACK 聚合) vs domestic(顺丰开放平台/快递100)。状态映射(status_mappings)仅 international 启用 encryption: API Key/Secret 字段必须加密存储（AES-256） webhook: AfterShip Webhook 推送 + 定时任务拉取双重保障 deduplication: tracking_checkpoints 通过联合唯一索引 (shipment_id, checkpoint_time, tag, message) 去重
